open_questions: The value pass is limited to what portable C gets from the compiler (SSE2 under MSVC). A register-blocked AVX-512 kernel (8 heads x 32 dims in 16 zmm accumulators, mul then add, no FMA) measured 94-136 GMAC/s vs 15-18 single-threaded and bit-identical (scratch prototype); it needs an hx_kernels entry (contract_issues) owned by the kernels task, then value_sum calls it.

Failed-call counter rollback is exact for demand reads; prefetch reads the call queued that complete after it returned are counted when they complete (no store API to wait for them). read_errors also counts failed prefetch reads, so it can be > 0 without any failed call.
The failure path ticks the store once (FAIL_NOW must clear so the next call retries); usage_out's tokens_observed and LFU decay therefore count a failed call as one token.
PAR_THREAD_NS (3000) and PAR_MIN_NS (6000) were calibrated on this Zen 5 machine under load; 1000 looked ~1-2% better for decode at 550 context but within noise. Re-measure on a quiet machine.
